cross_source_reconciliation.result: Drive and frozen-head gateway are the same semantic lineage for the inspected security surface.

security_findings.finding: One bearer API key hash protects the entire remote surface, including reads, creates and destructive calendar/todo/note deletes. There are no per-principal scopes, read/write separation or destructive-effect step-up capabilities.
security_findings.inheritance: Needle/gateway must use scoped principal/session capabilities; destructive effects require stronger explicit authority and intent binding.

security_findings.finding: allowed_endpoints and max_body_bytes exist in config.json.example but are not consumed by app.py/auth.py. The configured endpoint list has already drifted from actual parameterized runtime routes and omits /chat/vision.
security_findings.inheritance: Security policy must be executable typed configuration validated against the actual route/capability registry at boot; dead policy configuration must fail closed.

security_findings.finding: Voice and vision handlers fully buffer UploadFile data before checking 5MB/10MB limits; the configured 1MB max_body_bytes is unused.
security_findings.inheritance: Enforce streaming/request-body bounds before buffering and decoding.

security_findings.finding: Proxy helpers parse and return upstream JSON without raise_for_status or preserving upstream HTTP status. Parseable upstream failures can be flattened into gateway handler success semantics.
security_findings.inheritance: Effect result must preserve transport/status/provenance; operation success cannot be inferred from JSON parse success.

security_findings.finding: Rate limiting is in-memory and keyed by client IP, resets on restart, multiplies across workers and conflates principals behind shared addresses.
security_findings.inheritance: Rate/abuse state should bind authenticated principal/session and use shared durable/monotonic state when multi-worker.

security_findings.finding: SHA-256 token hash is compared using ordinary inequality rather than a standard constant-time secret comparison.
security_findings.inheritance: Use standard secret verification/rotation and constant-time comparison primitives.

security_findings.finding: Vision raw model text is interpolated into a normal Core /chat request with an instruction to ignore fabricated details; source-stage confidence, contradiction and percept evidence are not preserved as typed state.
security_findings.inheritance: Dissolved Retina must deliver typed VisualPercept evidence into FRANK state. Natural-language refinement is a presentation layer, never the evidence contract.

positive_controls: All non-health exposed endpoints use an authentication dependency.
Upload handlers attempt explicit nominal size limits.
Gateway binds by documented usage to loopback and internal upstreams are explicit.
Audit middleware records path/status/latency/client address without logging bearer token values.

frank: Remote interface authority and perception provenance must be typed state, not implicit in one bearer credential or prose.
needle: Split remote capabilities by principal and effect class; destructive routes cannot share generic chat/read authority.
harness: Test dead-config detection, route-registry parity, body-limit-before-buffering, status propagation, key scopes and destructive-action authorization.
claycode: External calls need typed Principal, Capability, EffectRequest and EffectResult values.
unifieddb: Persist principal/session capability issuance, effect request/result provenance and revocation state.
gwt: Do not broadcast a proxied failure as success or raw vision prose as sensor truth.
clay: One-module fusion must keep the remote authority boundary and typed percept boundary explicit.
